screens.name: Home — default, omen fixture, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows the illustrated hero, empty and populated omen states, enlarged text and transition; supplied runtime reports browser reflow, contrast and motion checks.
findings: Reduce the enlarged layout’s decorative vertical footprint so the omen’s content is easier to discover above the persistent navigation.

screens.name: Approach — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 1 consistently pairs the orb with an opening status and next-step explanation, while the enlarged version changes alignment and prominence.
findings: Preserve a more consistent relationship between the orb and status text across text sizes.

screens.name: Question composer — normal, large text, transition and task captures
screens.evidence: Sheets 1, 3, 32 and 33 show a labeled question, context selector and dominant submission button, with supplied runtime reporting enlarged submission visibility.
findings: Give the secondary voice action a little more bottom breathing room in the enlarged composition.

screens.name: Named-person composer — collapsed, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 2 shows Alex retained in the context row and question, but the question’s input boundary is less apparent than in the self composer.
findings: Keep the editable question’s visual affordance consistent between the named-person and self composers.

screens.name: Person editor — selected Someone, named input, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 2–3 show selection, a labeled Alex input, explanatory copy and confirmation, while runtime reports validation, cancellation and focus return.
findings: Keep Cancel changes readily discoverable after the enlarged confirmation button.

screens.name: Question card 1 — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 4 shows a consistent four-option list and numeric progress, with the decorative orb removed from the enlarged composition.
findings: Clarify whether choosing an answer immediately advances, since the settled list does not communicate that consequence.

screens.name: Question card 2 — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 4–5 show a short question, distinct answer rows and 2 of 3 progress with consistent transition styling.
findings: Show a brief selected-answer acknowledgement before any automatic advance.

screens.name: Question card 3 — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 5–6 show the final question and four choices with 3 of 3 progress but no visible explanation of the final selection’s consequence.
findings: Make it clear that the final answer starts forecast preparation.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, disabled Continue, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 6 shows a labeled multiline input, an explanatory disabled state and Back to choices, supplemented by reported constrained-height draft and focus checks.
findings: Separate Back to choices more clearly from the progress count in the enlarged header.

screens.name: Voice entry — unavailable, fallback, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 clearly presents voice failure, a dominant typing fallback and a retry action, with actual voice fallback reported in retained browser evidence.
findings: Distinguish denied permission from unavailable voice support when the browser can identify the cause.

screens.name: Planning — loading, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 22–23 show preparation status, a one-minute expectation, credit reassurance and cancellation, with supplied runtime reporting timeout and cancel recovery.
findings: Use a visibly updated status if preparation approaches the stated minute.

screens.name: Research — loading, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 distinguish research through supporting copy while retaining the same loading headline, orb and cancellation treatment.
findings: Make the change from checking the question to forming the forecast more immediately recognizable.

screens.name: Planning error — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 8 shows a dominant retry, question editing and explicit no-charge reassurance; runtime identifies the displayed message as a synthetic fixture.
findings: Retain this concise recovery hierarchy when displaying actual engine messages.

screens.name: Prediction error — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 8–9 add Review answers between retry and question editing, and runtime reports actual failure and retry coverage.
findings: Keep the distinction between reviewing existing answers and restarting the question explicit during recovery.

screens.name: Sensitive planning response — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 26–27 prioritize support, provide alternate question paths and explain credit and memory handling below the actions.
findings: Move the short credit and memory reassurance nearer the response explanation so enlarged-text users encounter it sooner.

screens.name: Sensitive prediction response — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 27 preserves the support-first hierarchy across sizes, while supplied runtime reports no credit spent and no memory addition.
findings: Keep the reassurance close to the explanation rather than beyond both secondary actions.

screens.name: Forecast reveal — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 25–26 show qualification before a complete forecast, a check-back date and prominent sharing, with runtime reporting intact text and successful reflow.
findings: Explain that the November check-in is an interim review when the forecast itself refers to spring.

screens.name: Check-in — unselected, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 7 prioritizes the outcome question above evidence and sharing, while enlarged text places remaining choices below the viewport.
findings: Keep all three outcome choices visually grouped and make their continuation below the initial enlarged viewport easy to discover.

screens.name: Check-in — Yes saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows Saved · Came true above a checked Yes row, with outcome persistence reported in the runtime evidence.
findings: Use consistent wording between the selected answer and saved-status label.

screens.name: Check-in — Not quite saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows a matching saved-status message and checked Not quite row before secondary actions.
findings: Maintain the immediate saved acknowledgement when users revise an outcome.

screens.name: Check-in — Not yet saved, normal and 200% task captures
screens.evidence: Sheets 21 and 32 show a checked Not yet choice and saved status at both sizes, with the enlarged capture visibly scrolled.
findings: Keep the pending-status symbol and wording consistent between check-in and History.

screens.name: Evidence index — normal, large text, transition and task captures
screens.evidence: Sheets 24 and 33 show four distinct evidence categories with descriptions, counts, navigation chevrons and a forecast-context disclosure.
findings: Keep Current sources and forecast context easy to discover after the enlarged category list.

screens.name: Evidence index — expanded forecast context, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 33–34 show Which forecast expanded with the original headline and qualification, and runtime reports exact full-headline retention.
findings: Consider placing forecast context nearer the index heading to reduce travel when users need orientation.

screens.name: Free Why reader — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 25–26 show qualification and three separated prose sections with a clear return path, using explicitly synthetic long-content fixtures.
findings: Label the prose sections as context, assumptions and limits so readers can scan their roles without parsing every paragraph.

screens.name: Evidence reason reader — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows separated reasoning paragraphs and both evidence and forecast return paths, with full-reader text coverage reported.
findings: Add concise section labels to distinguish supplied facts from scenario assumptions and background limitations.

screens.name: Evidence answers reader — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 9–10 show individually labeled answer blocks in a long scrolling reader, with synthetic repeated text explicitly identified as a stress fixture.
findings: Use the original question as each answer block’s heading so its meaning remains apparent during long-form review.

screens.name: Evidence assumptions reader — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows a clearly named assumptions reader, qualification and return navigation, while supplied runtime states the original fixture string is preserved.
findings: Present multiple assumptions as separately scannable items when more than one condition is available.

screens.name: Evidence sources reader — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 separate publication, date, long source text and an external link while explicitly stating that sources do not verify the forecast.
findings: Strengthen the source-title role so publication metadata does not dominate identification of each source.

screens.name: History — empty, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a centered empty state, local-storage explanation and Ask the Ball action with persistent navigation.
findings: Give the empty-state Ask action slightly stronger visual emphasis as the sole content action.

screens.name: History — populated single entry, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows date, original question, complete forecast and check-in cue, with runtime reporting preserved strings and month-label reflow.
findings: Bring the Open check-in cue closer to the forecast so the enlarged row’s action is easier to discover.

screens.name: History — multiple entries and persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 distinguishes dated entries and shows Came true replacing the first entry’s check-back label, supported by reported persistence checks.
findings: Retain a consistent outcome vocabulary between these rows and the check-in editor.

screens.name: Sky — sample stars, selected question, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 30–31 show explicit offline sample labeling, Retry, selected Love and its question, while enlarged categories extend vertically below the viewport.
findings: Keep the selected question nearer its category in the enlarged layout so selection and result remain connected.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 7 shows offline status, Retry, disabled creation and unavailable eligibility, with runtime explicitly limiting the main preview to offline Circles.
findings: Consolidate the two introductory circle descriptions to make the unavailable state and recovery path more prominent.

screens.name: Age confirmation — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show an explicit age question, two unambiguous answers and a brief explanation, with age-boundary checks reported.
findings: Preserve the equally explicit wording of both age choices throughout subsequent recovery.

screens.name: Birthday onboarding — optional, normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 17–18 show labeled date parts, an example, optional status and Skip, with enlarged fields stacked vertically and date-boundary checks reported.
findings: Tighten nonessential vertical spacing in the enlarged form so Continue and Skip require less scrolling.

screens.name: Age blocked — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 clearly explains the age restriction and offers birthday correction, while runtime reports eligibility boundaries.
findings: Use recovery wording appropriate to whether the user supplied a birthday or only selected an age category.

screens.name: Birthday correction — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 shows required birthday correction, the continuing age requirement and a return path, with enlarged form actions below the pictured viewport.
findings: Reduce the enlarged form’s spacing overhead without reducing the requested text scale.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — unselected, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 19–21 show four choices, optionality, Sun-sign context and Meet the Ball, including enlarged captures at a scrolled position.
findings: Make the no-selection path explicit in the action label or adjacent text instead of relying on users to interpret Meet the Ball as Skip.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — selected, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 distinguishes Learning & growth through gold text, a checkmark and a stronger separator across sizes.
findings: Maintain the checkmark alongside color whenever the selected focus appears elsewhere.

screens.name: Plans — yearly selected, monthly and packs, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 22 shows clear test-mode labeling, annual and monthly prices, selected Yearly and simulated pack actions, with actual payments explicitly unverified.
findings: Reduce enlarged plan spacing so the selected price, billing cadence and continuation action are easier to review together.

screens.name: Share — initial preview, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 29–30 show a tall preview, enlargement link, dimensions, download action and privacy explanation, with browser PNG export reported.
findings: Shorten the initial preview footprint at enlarged text so Download image is discovered sooner.

screens.name: Share — expanded options and scrolled controls, normal and 200%
screens.evidence: Sheets 29–30 and 34 show distinct download, invitation, reminder and return actions with privacy descriptions and supplied focus coverage.
findings: Clarify the invitation and reminder disclosure’s expanded state with a conventional chevron rather than a trailing dash.

screens.name: Shared-image inspection / Story — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 28–29 and 31–32 show a larger image, readable speculative qualification and an Image text transcript below it, with inspection focus reported.
findings: Give users an immediate cue that a selectable text transcript continues beneath the image.

screens.name: Export — preparing / held
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows disabled download and one Preparing image status, supported by explicitly retained prior evidence of single encoding after double activation.
findings: Place preparation status immediately above the disabled action to make the temporary state quicker to identify.

screens.name: Export — failure and retry
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows an explicit export failure and Try download again, with retained browser evidence reporting a real PNG after retry.
findings: Retain the preview and privacy context throughout retry so recovery does not feel like restarting sharing.

screens.name: You — profile, plan and populated memory, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 36 separates birth profile, plan and remembered focus, with edit and forget actions and reported memory and storage checks.
findings: Reduce oversized gaps around birth-profile actions so plan and memory information are less deeply buried at 200%.

screens.name: You — settings controls and empty memory, normal and large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 28 shows empty-memory explanation, labeled switches and utility actions in scrolled views, with actual motion and storage behavior reported.
findings: Group appearance controls separately from account and destructive actions to improve scanning through the enlarged settings list.

screens.name: You — birthday editing, normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 35–36 show populated labeled date fields, Save, Cancel and a collapsed removal action, supported by reported editor and retention checks.
findings: Keep the enlarged form’s save and cancel actions closer to the final date field.

screens.name: You — optional birth details, normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 34–35 show birth time, city lookup, disabled actions and optionality, while the normal viewport ends with only the top of the next button visible.
findings: Move Close birth details beside the section heading and reduce introductory spacing so the form and its actions are easier to scan.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home and loading sheets show a distinctive illustrated gold orb, while supplied runtime reports actual canvas motion, reduced-motion behavior and isolated frame timing.
findings: Preserve the hero’s prominence while reducing its competition with useful content in enlarged Home layouts.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Main-screen sheets show labeled destinations, a raised Ask orb and gold selected indicators, with reported browser target bounds of at least 44×44.
findings: Keep the active destination as visually legible as the permanently prominent Ask orb.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently show identity or page title beside balance, with enlarged balances wrapping to two lines and reveal showing zero remaining.
findings: Reduce the enlarged balance block’s competition with page headings while preserving its full readable wording.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream buttons consistently identify primary actions, including multiline and disabled examples, with browser contrast and target checks reported.
findings: Keep long action labels concise so enlarged buttons avoid unnecessary two-line height.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold links and white separator rows recur for navigation, cancellation, editing and recovery, supported by reported browser keyboard checks.
findings: Use a more consistent distinction between navigational links and actions that change the current task.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Question cards show generous separated rows, while outcome and focus states demonstrate checked selections.
findings: Provide equivalent visible selection acknowledgement on question cards before advancing.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Composer captures show a persistent label and conspicuous rectangular outline around a multiline serif question, with input and focus checks reported.
findings: Refine the double-line appearance so the input boundary remains clear without feeling heavier than the surrounding interface.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged question, name and custom-answer inputs remain readable, with supplied evidence reporting exact 2× fields, draft retention and constrained-height checks.
findings: Preserve enlarged input text while tightening surrounding explanatory spacing where actions approach the viewport edge.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 28 shows labeled switches with knob position and color differences, supplemented by reported keyboard, persistence and actual motion checks.
findings: Make switch-state contrast more visually distinct without relying solely on gold versus gray.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 15 shows both a populated omen and explicit No omen today guidance, while enlarged content continues beneath the initial viewport.
findings: Allocate more initial Home space to the omen beneath its heading at 200% text.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 31 connects checked Love with a sample question and Ask this too, while sheet 30 shows the enlarged category arrangement.
findings: Keep selected category and question adjacent in the enlarged presentation.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: The offline Circles capture explicitly disables creation and eligibility while preserving Retry and privacy explanations.
findings: Remove repetitive introduction text so the offline explanation and recovery action lead the section.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show complete date, question, forecast and outcome or check-back status separated into readable rows.
findings: Bring the row’s check-in cue closer to its forecast in the enlarged version.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 22 distinguishes selected Yearly with a check and gold rule while displaying annual billing, equivalent monthly cost and savings.
findings: Keep total billing amount and cadence visually together before the equivalent monthly price.

components.name: Share preview card
components.evidence: Share sheets show a coherent portrait card with speculative qualification, enlargement access and a separate transcript in inspection.
findings: Reduce decorative space inside compact previews so forecast and qualification are easier to inspect without enlargement.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error, voice and export captures consistently expose failure and usable alternatives, with actual browser recovery paths reported.
findings: Keep cause, retained work and next action close together in every enlarged recovery state.

components.name: Typography and spacing system
components.evidence: The sheets consistently combine expressive serif headings with sans-serif controls, supported by reported exact enlargement and zero visible overflow across 246 states.
findings: Tighten oversized vertical gaps at 200% while retaining the exact text enlargement and complete content.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and restrained gold illumination remain coherent across sheets, with supplied runtime reporting composited contrast and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Retain the quieter atmosphere behind dense readers and utility tasks.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Onboarding and profile captures consistently label Day, Month and Year and provide an example, with date and age boundaries reported.
findings: Keep validation adjacent to the relevant field and shorten the enlarged stack’s spacing.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: Age-confirmation captures offer explicit 13-or-older and under-13 actions, with blocked and correction states also represented.
findings: Ensure correction labels accurately reflect whether the preceding input was an age choice or a birthday.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Unselected and selected focus captures show consistent rows with checkmark, gold text and separator emphasis.
findings: Make proceeding without a selection explicit alongside the primary action.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: You captures group Sun sign, age band and birthday with editing and optional-detail actions.
findings: Compact the profile action spacing so plan and memory remain easier to discover at enlarged text.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheet 35 shows time format guidance, city input, disabled lookup and instructions, with the next action only partially visible at the viewport bottom.
findings: Place the collapse action at the section heading and bring the lookup and save sequence into a tighter visual group.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 2–3 show selected Someone, a labeled first-name field and explicit confirmation, with validation and focus return reported.
findings: Keep selection, first-name input and confirmation visually connected when the editor expands at 200%.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Evidence captures show category chevrons and a Which forecast control with distinct collapsed and expanded states.
findings: Use navigation chevrons for reader destinations and disclosure chevrons only for content that expands in place.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Sheet 12 distinguishes preparation from failure and retry, with retained evidence reporting single preparation and successful PNG recovery.
findings: Keep status immediately associated with the download control throughout preparation and retry.

components.name: Close, back and progress controls
components.evidence: Flow captures show persistent close or back controls and numeric card progress, supplemented by reported browser target and focus checks.
findings: Keep progress and Back to choices visually separate so they do not read as one crowded header string.

components.name: Saved-outcome status
components.evidence: Saved check-in states put explicit acknowledgement before secondary actions, and History visibly reflects a persisted outcome.
findings: Standardize Yes versus Came true wording across selection, acknowledgement and history.

limitations: Scores are provisional browser assessments using the attached screenshots and supplied runtime account; no independent runtime drive or additional file inspection was performed.
Corresponding transitions and text-size variants are grouped with their settled screen; still images support visual consistency but cannot establish temporal continuity or absence of layout shifts.

For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1), excluding only genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.
The authorized A≥9 and F≥9 threshold is not met; the main remaining weaknesses are enlarged-layout efficiency, evidence-reader scanning and some action affordances.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied material; viewport-edge continuation and scrolled captures are not evidence of lost or unreachable content.
Browser target bounds, contrast, reflow, reduced motion, focus and recovery checks are credited as reported evidence rather than inferred from screenshots.
Some validation, keyboard, reader, export and recovery evidence is explicitly retained from earlier work rather than rerun in this round.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native text settings, microphone, haptics, OS share delivery and actual payments remain unverified and receive no full/native certification.
Offline Circles and sample Sky do not establish production social or authentication behavior; separate adapter journeys do not close that boundary.
Synthetic long-content, source, error and prediction fixtures establish layout coverage only and are not treated as production-copy defects or proof of predictive quality.
No distinct confirmation modal is pictured, so modal behavior and accessibility cannot be separately assessed.
topFixes: Reduce decorative and inter-section spacing at 200% text, especially Home, birth details, birthday forms, plans and sharing, while preserving exact text scale and scrolling.
Add concise role labels to reasoning sections so context, assumptions and limitations are immediately scannable.
Keep selected Sky categories near their resulting question and make question-card selection acknowledgement and advance consequences explicit.
Clarify interim check-in dates when the forecast horizon is later, and standardize outcome wording across check-in and History.
Standardize navigation versus expansion indicators and preserve consistent edit affordances across self and named-person composers.
